anthropic.note: Sonnet for every class (owner decision 2026-10-27, option A: no silent cost increase for development). roleModels then puts Patch Assurance, the Process Judge and the Epic Process Judge on Opus (owner decision 2026-10-27, cost note: review roles only); Development, ATDD, the Conductor and Code Review stay Sonnet through their class. Resolution: run override per role, then policy roleModels, then models[executionClass]; effort always comes from the role's reasoningTier. Review roles never go below reviewModelFloors (ACEF-owned; update-acef-installation resets it) or, for a run override, below the policy's model; strength comes only from modelRank (weakest first), and a review-role model missing from modelRank is rejected. A lower or null review-role model needs roleModelExemptions.<role> (host policy) or active-run --routing-role-model-exemption "<role>: <reason>" (run). Development, ATDD and the Conductor are freely overridable. Effort is a recorded claim; the launcher must open the session at that effort. Select with active-run --routing-provider anthropic or a repo override activeProvider.
